name: dev-workflow
description: Standalone, zero-dependency atomic R&D workflow plugin (Brainstorm -> Save Design -> Parallel Improve Design -> Legacy-Safe Impl -> Adjustable Deep Review) tailored for legacy and greenfield repos.
